summary.text: Joe Sheehan is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 26 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican John Belanger.

paragraphs.text: Joe Sheehan earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University, a graduate degree from the University of Houston and a Ph.D. from Marquette University.
He defeated incumbent Republican Amy Binsfeld in the November 5, 2024 general election for Assembly District 26.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Education Committee and the Workforce Development Committee.
